note: Core vehicle design chain: mission drives engine, which drives tanks and structure
Engine subsystem chains: engine sizing feeds turbopump and stability analysis
GNC serves both ascent trajectory and reusable landing trajectory design
TPS, reusability, and structures share thermal and load environments
Launch ops executes the mission designed by trajectory and GNC chains
Tank pressurization drives pump NPSH which drives turbopump design
Combustion stability couples with feed system dynamics and pogo from tank design
Reusability affects launch ops turnaround and structural life assessment
Entry trajectory design in GNC defines the heating environment for TPS
Mission design payload penalty from reusability directly trades against delta-v budget
